listings.note: Prices are integer cents. No float may enter a signed receipt, so money is counted in the smallest unit rather than stored as a decimal.

consumer_v1.label: Consumer shopping agent
consumer_v1.summary: Shows the warning, lets the person decide
consumer_v1.description: An individual shopper's agent. Tolerates a warned outcome so long as the warning is put in front of the buyer. Never purchases without a human pressing the button.

autonomous_buyer_v1.label: Autonomous buying agent
autonomous_buyer_v1.description: Completes the purchase itself when every check passes and nothing is flagged, with no person in the loop. A warned outcome is not clean enough to buy unattended, so it stops and asks. Spend is capped per line.

budget_guard_v1.label: Budget-controlled agent
budget_guard_v1.description: Trusts the product assessment exactly as far as any other actor does, then applies a spend ceiling of its own. A product it considers perfectly sound still goes to a person if the line total is over budget.

brand_loyal_v1.label: Brand-restricted agent
brand_loyal_v1.description: Acts for a buyer with a standing brand arrangement. A brand outside that arrangement is not a safety judgement and is never treated as one: the product assessment is untouched and the referral is recorded as the agent's own commercial constraint.

procurement_v1.label: Enterprise procurement agent
procurement_v1.summary: Approved vendors only, warnings go to a person
procurement_v1.description: A hospital procurement function answerable to audit. Will not accept a warned outcome without a person confirming it, and buys only from approved vendors.
